title: Hardcoded SF=12 instead of using computed sf variable
description:
File: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:225

When utilization > 200, returns hardcoded SFResult(12, False) instead of SFResult(sf, False), violating the pseudocode in the docstring which specifies returning the SF variable after the MIN operation.

**Failure scenario:** adaptive_sf_select(assigned_sf=7, density=0, ema_snr=0, utilization=201) returns SFResult(12, False) but should return SFResult(10, False) per the documented pseudocode.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
